title: Welcome to my site!
text:
Welcome to my site!



I am a Ph.D. student in the Department of Political Science at the University of Wisconsin–Madison working on international political economy. My research interests include inequality, global value chains, attitudes towards trade and domestic-side IR, which I study using both observational and experimental tools. Prior to coming to UW, I completed my master’s and B.A. in Political Science at McGill University.
I’d love to chat about your research. Feel free to reach out to me at john[dot]hicks[at]wisc[dot]edu.
